findings.note: Item 4 answer states 'Only someone with legal authority to sign. That might be the owner, a trustee, an executor or administrator, or several heirs who agree. Living in the house alone does not give you that authority.' This is a list of legal roles and a legal conclusion with no cited claim; the ledger has no claim on who holds authority to sell (claim_ids is empty). Remove the role list and the flat conclusion, or say only that who can sign depends on how title is held and must be confirmed with an attorney or title company.
